quality_tier_effects.description: Minimal prime - reduced prep, basic coverage only
quality_tier_effects.notes: Economy work: quick inspection, coverage-only application

quality_tier_effects.description: Standard prime - baseline for all rates
quality_tier_effects.notes: Standard new construction: proper prep, single coat, clean edges

quality_tier_effects.description: Premium prime - thorough prep, careful application, crisp edges
quality_tier_effects.notes: Premium work: detailed inspection, straight edges, possible light sand

texture_effects.notes: Orange peel texture increases surface area ~15%, slows application ~15%
Knockdown texture increases surface area ~25%, slows application ~20%

drywall_level_effects.notes: Level 3 has more exposed paper, higher absorption, slightly slower application
Level 5 is uniform surface, slightly better coverage, but may require sand after prime

coupling_constraints.description: When using spray+backroll, spray rate must not exceed backroll rate. Backroller sets the pace.
coupling_constraints.practical_implication: Spray at 600 SF/hr, backroll at 400 SF/hr means effective rate is 400 SF/hr per crew
coupling_constraints.notes: Spray and backroll typically done by 2-person crew, but bottleneck is backroll rate

crew_configurations.name: Single Roller
crew_configurations.notes: One person does cut-in and rolling

crew_configurations.name: Roller Pair
crew_configurations.notes: Cutter stays ahead of roller for larger areas

crew_configurations.name: Spray + Backroll Crew
crew_configurations.notes: Sprayer and backroller work in tandem. Backroller sets pace.
